name: avatar-imaging
description: Server-side avatar imaging API (Habbo habbo-imaging/avatarimage equivalent) for the Nitro renderer. Renders figures to PNG / animated APNG in headless Chromium for use with a CMS.
comment: The renderer is consumed via `yarn link "@nitrots/nitro-renderer"` and Vite aliases (see vite.harness.config.mjs), the same as Nitro-UI — so it is intentionally NOT a registry dependency here.
